_readme: Generated by pipeline/plans_tod.py from the plan's Priority Project Recommendations, Detailed List. Do not edit by hand; change ALIASES or TREATMENTS in the script and rerun.
title: Transit-Oriented Development Pedestrian Access Plan
short: the city's 2022 plan for walking to Caltrain stations
method: This plan recommends changes on walking routes near the Downtown, Hayward Park and Hillsdale Caltrain stations and along El Camino Real. It doesn't rank them. The changes listed here are grouped into plain categories; the plan's project list has the full wording.
